title: PageExtractWire
description: Lean VLM diplomatic observation contract for a single scanned correspondence page.

printed_folio.description: Exact page number or folio printed on the leaf (e.g. 'xii', '42', '[14]'), or null if unnumbered.

page_orientation.description: Observed physical orientation of the printed text on the scan.

warning_codes.description: Page-level archival observation flags (e.g. blank_page, tissue_guard, illegible_region, clipped_margin, dense_apparatus, two_tier_apparatus, multi_letter_page, sideways_table, multi_column, handwritten_annotation, archaic_orthography, mixed_scripts, jbig2_risk).

blocks.description: All visual regions on the page in exact diplomatic reading order.

type.description: Semantic archival block role: margin_note for outer-margin shoulder chronology/age notes (e.g. '1831. Æt. 39.'); address_block for superscriptions, postal marks, and recipient endorsements (e.g. 'Ansd. 12 May'); table_caption/table_row/toc_entry for Calendar or Register of Letters.

bbox.description: Normalized [x0, y0, x1, y1] bounding box coordinates in 0..1000 scale (preserving left vs right outer margin side for margin_note shoulder notes).

text.description: 100% verbatim diplomatic transcription using ONLY constrained inline tags: <i>, <b>, <sc>, <fnref> (exclusively for footnote/endnote/variant callout markers), <sup> (purely typographic superscripts like yᵉ, Sʳ, dº, 5ᵗʰ), <sub>, <unclear>. Preserve archaic orthography, medial long-s (ſ), ligatures (æ, œ), cipher/redaction dashes (M——, ***), and editorial brackets ([? 1848], [torn], [sic]) exactly as printed.

alignment.description: Printed spatial layout of the block (use 'cascading' for stepped multi-line valedictions/signatures, 'right' for right-aligned datelines/signatures).

epistolary_transition.description: Structural transition: 'starts_new_letter' at the opening block of every top-level letter, telegram, postcard, or short note (including multiple per page); 'starts_enclosure' and 'ends_enclosure' for nested quoted letters/documents enclosed inside a parent letter.

line_breaks_preserved.description: True when printed line breaks carry structural/typographic meaning (verse, cascading valedictions, multi-line datelines, address blocks, signatures, telegrams).

heading_level.description: Heading hierarchy level (1=part/chapter, 2=major section, 3=subsection, 4=minor subheading), or null.

note_label.description: Exact printed marker opening a footnote or margin note, supporting two-tier apparatus on the same page (e.g. textual variant letters 'a', 'b', 'c' alongside explanatory numbers '1', '2', '3' or resetting symbols '*', '†', '‡', '§', '‖', '¶'), or null if unlabelled continuation.

continues_from_prev.description: True when this paragraph, footnote, or table continues directly from the previous page or column.

continues_to_next.description: True when this paragraph, footnote, or table breaks mid-sentence or mid-unit at the bottom of the page.

table_role.description: Structural role of a table_row block (including Calendar / Register of Letters tables), or null.

cells.description: Structured left-to-right cells for table_row blocks, or null.
